resources.string: Tapkey uses this service solely to perform the system Lock Screen action upon tapping the Lock Screen Quick Settings tile.
Instantly locks your phone from the notification shade without using the hardware power button.
Opens the native system volume slider popup without pressing the physical volume buttons.
The Lock Screen tile requires Accessibility permission to perform the system lock screen action safely without root or device administration rights.
If Android grays out the toggle under Accessibility, open App Info > tap the three dots menu (top right) > select \"Allow restricted settings\".
